title: Polynomial-time test from a computable run
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over bits, and let $c,B,e$ be natural numbers. If the map sending each bit string $x$ to the output of the associated dynamic-programming run is polynomial-time computable, then the function sending $x$ to the one-bit output containing the value of the test on $x$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over bits
The dynamic-programming run map is polynomial-time computable
